name: Aurelian Empire
tagline: Maritime empire of navy and bureaucracy
summary: A powerful maritime empire defined by navy, bureaucracy, standardization, etiquette and the belief that power creates responsibility.
gateAttitude: Aurelia treats magic as a strategic asset requiring responsible administration.
beliefs: Aurelia follows the **Faith of the First Light**, a religious family it shares with Vesper, in the form of the **Aurelian Communion**, also called the **Crowned Sun**. It emphasizes order, duty, stewardship, continuity and reciprocal hierarchy. Older folklore that predates the First Light also survives.
visualSummary: Polished brass, navy and cream uniforms, monumental institutions and standardized equipment.

relations.text: Old naval rivalry and mutual respect.
Shares the Faith of the First Light, read differently.

sponsorFraming: Aurelian sponsorship represents logistics, manifests, standardized supply and contingency planning.
extraRule: Once per session, bring one item from your Personal Stash into action without paying the normal Stress or Fate Point cost.
